Protection you can see and control.

The problem and why it matters

Fraud protection can miss the mark in both directions.

Customers need their debit cards to work when a purchase is real and to stop a purchase when it is not. The wrong decision creates a problem for customers and for the bank.

01

Real purchases get blocked.

A valid purchase may be incorrectly flagged as fraud. The customer is left at checkout unable to complete it.

Who feels it: the customer whose everyday payment is interrupted.

02

Fraudulent purchases can go through.

Current detection can miss true fraud. When the purchase succeeds, both customers and the bank can lose money.

Who feels it: the customer and the bank.

03

Recovery takes too long.

After fraud is detected, a physical replacement debit card can take five days or more to arrive by mail.

Why it matters: customers may lose easy access to their funds while they wait.

Our team's proposed solution

Make the fraud decision clear. Keep the customer connected.

Everyday Access pairs an AI purchase check with an immediate digital recovery option. The customer stays part of the decision.

01 · Decide together

Check every purchase. Ask when something looks unusual.

An AI decision engine reviews each purchase. If one looks unusual, the customer gets an in-app request to confirm whether it is theirs.

  • ✓ YesThe legitimate purchase continues without disruption.
  • ✕ NoThe fraudulent purchase is blocked, and recovery begins.
02 · Restore access

Offer a mobile debit card while the physical card is mailed.

After the customer identifies fraud, they can choose an instant digital debit card. If they agree, it is issued right away for a supported mobile wallet while they wait for the replacement physical card.

EVERYDAY ACCESS · DIGITAL DEBIT Connected to your funds ✓ Mobile access ready

Wallet availability depends on identity verification, device eligibility, wallet compatibility, and merchant acceptance.

The goal is simple: protect customers' funds without adding unnecessary disruption to their lives.
